body:
Sketched it to see: enum View<'a> { Comment { body }, Reply { body, in_reply_to }, … Opaque(&Event) }, a borrowed view layered over the flat struct, with malformed events collapsing into Opaque. Decided against it for now.

The view's match restates the §2.1 validation table — two encodings that can drift, and they can't merge because validation also checks *forbidden* fields, which a view can't express. And most readers need the shared header (ts, author) alongside the per-kind field, so they'd end up juggling the event and its view. Today's entire cost is two defensive guards in fold.rs; the vocabulary has grown by one kind (mirror) in the project's life. Revisit if it starts growing for real.
